intro: Explore Ayia Napa on the southeast coast of Cyprus: Nissi Beach, the harbour, Cape Greco, sea caves, family attractions and lively evenings. Save your holiday plans, favourite visits and photographs on this device.

areas.name: Ayia Napa Centre
areas.description: Shops, restaurants, monastery square and nightlife streets.

areas.name: Ayia Napa Harbour
areas.description: Fishing boats, waterfront dining and sightseeing cruises.

areas.name: Nissi Beach area
areas.description: Popular beach resort with shallow turquoise water and beach facilities.

areas.name: Makronissos
areas.description: Sandy beaches and a quieter resort atmosphere west of the centre.

areas.name: Cape Greco
areas.description: Protected coastal landscape with viewpoints and trails.

areas.name: Protaras
areas.description: Nearby resort known for Fig Tree Bay and family beaches.

attractions.name: Ayia Napa Monastery
attractions.description: Historic landmark in the town centre; check current visiting arrangements.

attractions.name: Cape Greco National Forest Park
attractions.description: Coastal viewpoints, nature trails and dramatic limestone scenery.

attractions.name: Ayia Napa Sea Caves
attractions.description: Beautiful coastal formations; admire from safe viewpoints and avoid cliff jumping.

attractions.name: Love Bridge
attractions.description: Natural rock arch and scenic coastal photo stop.

attractions.name: Thalassa Municipal Museum
attractions.description: Exhibits exploring the sea, marine heritage and Cyprus history.

attractions.name: Ayia Napa Sculpture Park
attractions.description: Outdoor sculptures with sea views; bring sun protection.

attractions.name: Ayia Napa Harbour
attractions.description: Boat trips, fishing boats and seafront strolls.

transport.name: Larnaca International Airport
transport.description: Common arrival airport for Ayia Napa; check current transfer options.

transport.name: Local buses
transport.description: Check current OSEA routes for Ayia Napa, Protaras and Paralimni.

transport.name: Intercity buses
transport.description: Check current services for Larnaca and other Cyprus towns.

transport.name: Licensed taxis
transport.description: Confirm meter use or agree a price before setting off.

transport.name: Car hire
transport.description: Cyprus drives on the left; check insurance, parking and road conditions.

transport.name: Walking and cycling
transport.description: Promenade walks are pleasant; use caution on roads and in summer heat.

useful.name: Currency
useful.description: Euro (€); check card charges and exchange rates.

useful.name: Travel documents
useful.description: Check UK passport and Cyprus entry rules before departure.

useful.name: Languages
useful.description: Greek and Turkish are official languages; English is widely spoken in tourist areas.

useful.name: Driving
useful.description: Drive on the left and follow local road rules.

useful.name: Time zone
useful.description: Cyprus is normally two hours ahead of the UK.

useful.name: Sun and heat
useful.description: Carry water and sun cream; avoid prolonged midday exposure.

useful.name: Sea safety
useful.description: Check beach flags, lifeguard advice and boat-trip weather.

useful.name: Nature protection
useful.description: Respect protected habitats around Cape Greco and marked paths.

beaches.name: Nissi Beach
beaches.description: Famous sandy beach with clear water; can be busy in peak season.

beaches.name: Makronissos Beach
beaches.description: Sandy bay popular for swimming and relaxing.

beaches.name: Landa Beach
beaches.description: Sandy beach between Nissi and Makronissos.

beaches.name: Grecian Bay (Pantachou Beach)
beaches.description: Long sandy beach near the harbour.

beaches.name: Konnos Bay
beaches.description: Sheltered scenic bay near Cape Greco; access includes slopes and steps.

beaches.name: Fig Tree Bay
beaches.description: Popular beach in nearby Protaras; check lifeguard and swimming conditions.

markets.name: Ayia Napa town shops
markets.description: Souvenirs, beachwear and holiday essentials around the centre.

markets.name: Local bakeries
markets.description: Try Cypriot pastries, breads and snacks.

markets.name: Paralimni shopping
markets.description: Nearby town for additional shops and everyday essentials.

markets.name: Supermarkets
markets.description: Groceries and picnic supplies around the resort.

nightlife.name: Ayia Napa Square
nightlife.description: Bars and music venues; busiest in the main holiday season.

nightlife.name: Protaras evenings
nightlife.description: Alternative nearby resort with family-friendly dining and entertainment.

family.name: WaterWorld Waterpark
family.description: Seasonal themed waterpark; check opening dates and ride restrictions.

family.name: Nissi Beach
family.description: Family beach time; supervise children and follow beach safety signs.

family.name: Harbour boat trips
family.description: Choose licensed operators and check sea conditions.

family.name: Thalassa Museum
family.description: Indoor option to explore local maritime history.

family.name: Sculpture Park
family.description: Open-air art and coastal views; bring water and hats.

dining.name: Ayia Napa town centre

dining.name: Beachfront cafés
